The second constructs an incorrect practice schedule and also miscalculates its displayed quotient.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02603","case1_error":"Returns 200 pairs instead of converting them into the requested 400 individual plugs.","case2_error":"Treats the 70 unheard lines as all lines written, excluding the seven sonnets already read.","reason":"The first answers in the wrong counting unit; the second mistakes a subset for the total.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02604","case1_error":"Gives unsupported final cost 475 after correct formulas; the stated calculation yields 752.","case2_error":"Gives unsupported final revenue 168 after a correct calculation plan; the required total is 216.","reason":"Both provide a correct setup or method followed by an unsupported incorrect number, without showing a numerical evaluation that identifies an arithmetic mistake.","judgment":"same"}]}
